history.summary: A 556-unit 99-year leasehold condo in Tanah Merah (D16), 450m from EW4 Tanah Merah MRT interchange, with a deep 118-txn URA series at 5.9%/yr. This 4BR at $1,612 psf is ~5% above the $1,535 median, and a $2.5M leasehold 4BR is a narrower OCR exit than the dev's broader resale market.
history.rating_rationale: Casa Merah is a solid, liquid Tanah Merah development — 556 units and 118 URA transactions support a reliable 5.9%/yr rate, and EW4 Tanah Merah (interchange for the Changi Airport branch) at 450m gives strong East-West Line connectivity plus TEL/Bayshore-precinct spillover. The reservations keep it at Neutral: the 4BR is listed ~5% ABOVE the $1,535 project median (a premium, not a discount); at $2.5M for a 99-year leasehold (2009, ~82 years left) the 4BR buyer pool is thinner than the project's 2-3BR resale market; and D16 OCR large-family units appreciate more slowly per sqft. A dependable asset bought slightly above median in the less-liquid unit type — Neutral.
red_flags: Listed ~5% above the project URA median — paying a premium
$2.5M leasehold 4BR — narrower OCR exit than the 2-3BR market
Leasehold; OCR large-family units appreciate slower per sqft
catalysts: 450m to EW4 Tanah Merah MRT interchange — strong East-West connectivity
Bayshore precinct / TEL and Upper East Coast transformation spillover
Large 556-unit development = deep buyer pool, reliable 5.9%/yr URA

agent_evaluation.rental_assessment: Good East-side tenant demand (airport, Changi Business Park, expat families near schools); a 1,550 sqft 4BR rents inefficiently per sqft but draws family tenants.
agent_evaluation.appreciation_assessment: 5.9%/yr URA is reliable, but the above-median entry and large-leasehold-unit drag cap forward return to around district-typical.
